patches.title: Clean After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up a dirty object, go directly to a sinkbasin and clean it.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding a dirty object that requires cleaning.

patches.title: Station Action Execution
patches.principle: When at the required transformation station and holding the object, perform the action immediately.
patches.when_to_apply: When at a sinkbasin, fridge, microwave, etc. with appropriate object.

patches.title: Place After Clean
patches.principle: After cleaning an object, go directly to the target receptacle and move the object there.
